title: ClarificationRequest
description: B4.C5 — Allows CEO to obtain missing information without becoming a second independent client relationship. Blocking vs non-blocking is explicit. why_needed may be translated into user-friendly language by Personal Hermes; it is never an excuse for Personal to answer on the client's behalf using inference.

allowed_context_refs.description: Context refs the answering role may consult without opening raw transcript.

answerable_from_canonical_state.description: Set true when the requesting actor verified the answer is NOT already available from canonical state / personal memory (duplicate-avoidance).
